_about: 2025 温网男单冠军是否为 1 号种子的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-06-20；使用截点前 ATP 官方排名信息。

evidence.title: On This Day: Jannik Sinner becomes first Italian to rise to No. 1 in 2024
evidence.excerpt: Jannik Sinner made history on 10 June 2024 when he became the first Italian to rise to No. 1 in the PIF ATP Rankings.
evidence.claim: 截至截点前，Sinner 仍处于 ATP 世界第一的长期位置，为温网头号种子提供直接排名依据。

evidence.title: Sinner on reality of No. 1: 'Everyone wants to beat you'
evidence.excerpt: Sinner became the 29th No. 1 in the PIF ATP Rankings ... Having comfortably retained his position ever since.
evidence.claim: 6 月 18 日 ATP 官方仍确认 Sinner 保持世界第一，紧邻温网种子确定窗口。
